department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month credited to the beneficiary's bank account through DBT.
eligibility: Resident of Vindhyachal for at least 10 years.
Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 1,20,000.
Not receiving any other government pension.
documents_required: Age proof (birth certificate / school leaving certificate / voter ID)
application_process: Apply online at the Social Justice portal or at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
The application is verified by the Block Social Welfare Officer within 30 days.
